CLI You can use Ultralytics YOLO directly from the Command Line Interface (CLI) with the yolo command: # Predict using a pretrained YOLO model (e.g., YOLO26n) on an image yolo predict model=yolo26n.pt source='https://ultralytics.com/images...' | and we ran the newest version, YOLO26. 저희는 최신 버전, YOLO26을 돌렸어요. | 1920 x 1080 | Each frame is shrunk to 640 pixels wide, 프레임을 가로 640픽셀로 줄이고, | bird 0.84 bird 0.72 bird 0.41 bird 0.81 bird 0.87 bird 0.84 bird 0.27 | ultralytics/ultralytics Code Issues Pull requests Discussions Actions GNU Affero General Public License v3.0 Permissions: Commercial use, Modification, Distribution Limitations: Liability, Warranty Conditions: License and copyright notice, State changes, Disclose source | Do this for every frame, 이걸 프레임마다 하면 | The code and models are AGPL-3.0. 코드와 모델은 AGPL-3.0이에요. | bird 0.86 bird 0.65 bird 0.88 bird 0.91 bird 0.70 | #2334455 | bus 0.94 | ultralytics source # cfg/default.yaml imgsz: 640 # [int | list] train/val use int (square); predict/export may use [h,w] # cfg/models/26/yolo26.yaml - [[16, 19, 22], 1, Detect, [nc]] # Detect(P3, P4, P5) # nn/modules/head.py self.nl = len(ch) # number of detection layers | horse 0.95 | bird 0.86 bird 0.85 | bird 0.86 bird 0.68 bird 0.88 bird 0.91 bird 0.70 | Thank you. 감사합니다. | @index.opensource @hyun2xyz",
  "key_claims": [
    "Ultralytics YOLO boxes and names every object it recognizes in a video, frame by frame",
    "YOLO stands for 'You Only Look Once', introduced by Joseph Redmon in 2015",
    "The demo runs the newest version, YOLO26 (caption specifies Ultralytics 8.4.173 and yolo26l.pt)",
    "Each frame is resized to 640 pixels wide and processed in a single pass",
    "The model predicts on three grids (fine to coarse) and each cell predicts one box plus class scores for 80 classes, totaling over 5,000 guesses (5,040 prediction cells)",
    "92 of the predicted boxes are labeled 'bird' with confidence above 25%",
    "Non-Maximum Suppression (NMS, IoU 0.7) removes overlapping duplicate boxes, leaving 12 bird detections",
    "YOLO26 has an NMS-free head option (nms=False) that names each object once, skipping NMS cleanup at a small accuracy cost; this returned 9 detections on the same frame",
    "These results are from a single frame, not a benchmark or guaranteed detection count",
    "The code and models are licensed under AGPL-3.0; using them in a product/online service requires sharing source code unless an Ultralytics Enterprise License is obtained"
  ],
  "info_channel": "caption"
}
